approach: Write docs/system-facts.md as short sourced bullets, with budget lines in a fixed parseable form (`- budget <set>: <size> of <budget>`). Embed it in briefs.rs as `pub const SYSTEM_FACTS: &str = include_str!(...)` and emit a "## System facts" section in planner_brief and critic_brief. In budgets.rs, factor the existing set composition into a helper that returns (name, size, budget) rows. Add a checker that parses the file's budget lines and compares them to the computed rows. Test it on the real file and on a doctored copy. Record the change in CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md.

decisions.choice: Embed the file with include_str! in a pub const in briefs.rs and add a '## System facts' section to both briefs, after the request and reading and before the plan or checks.
decisions.reason: Both briefs carry the same text and the binary has no runtime dependence on docs/. budgets.rs reads the same const, so the test checks what ships.

rejected.option: Read the file at run time
rejected.why: The run-time copy has no docs/ and the snapshot may not match the binary.

rejected.option: Put it in the system prompt frames
rejected.why: It would spend the fixed planner and critic prompt budgets, and the request does not ask to change those.

decisions.choice: Record sizes for the sets the budgets test already computes: contract, reader, producer, verifier, planner and critic. Producer and verifier use the maximum across capabilities. Compare the file's numbers to computed sizes and to BudgetSet::budget().
decisions.reason: Uses existing numbers, so it needs no new measurement code. Drift in either the budget or the size fails the test.

rejected.why: A longer file, and the request asks for a short one.

rejected.option: Add steward, audience and auditor sets
rejected.why: The budgets test does not compute them today; this is not required.

decisions.choice: The checker is a function returning Result<(), String> that takes the text and the computed rows. The tests call it on the real file (must pass) and on a copy with one number changed (must be Err).
decisions.reason: Gives the negative case the criteria ask for without editing files.

rejected.option: Only assert on the real file
rejected.why: It would not show that the test can fail.

decisions.choice: The file names boundary_words() in xtask/tests/policy.rs as the source and lists no banned word. It refers to the [personal_data] allow-list only by name.
decisions.reason: Satisfies criterion 2 and keeps the file clear of the scan.

rejected.why: Out of scope, and it would trip the scan.

files.purpose: Short sourced facts: the host squash-merges and main needs linear history and up-to-date branches; a producer works in a one-commit snapshot with no remote or other branches; the reader, planner and critic get a plain copy without git or records/; prompt budgets and sizes in parseable lines; the boundary words, by pointer to boundary_words() in xtask/tests/policy.rs; the plan request format; land lands only a job's PR; records live on athena/records after C0; SSH remote refused at admission; per-PR and per-branch caches; early PR and land waiting for CI.
Add pub const SYSTEM_FACTS via include_str!; add a '## System facts' section to planner_brief and critic_brief; add unit tests for inclusion and for file content (markers, no '@', no banned words).
Factor set sizes into a helper; add the facts-file checker, the real-file test and the doctored negative test.
Add an entry for the system-facts file, the brief inclusion and the drift test.
Record the decision: file, brief inclusion, drift test, and why the frames and budgets are unchanged.

steps: Read briefs.rs near boundary_words() (line 321), the briefs tests module (line 1137) and the planner and critic fixtures.
Grep the sources for each fact: host_rules.rs, records_branch.rs, land.rs, the plan request parser, SSH admission and the caches. Note each path.
Refactor budgets.rs so one helper returns rows (name, size, budget) for contract, reader, producer (max), verifier (max), planner and critic. Keep the existing tests passing.
Write docs/system-facts.md with every required fact and its 'Source:'. Budget lines take the form `- budget <set>: <size> of <budget>`, filled from the helper's output.
Add pub const SYSTEM_FACTS and the '## System facts' section to planner_brief and critic_brief.
Add the briefs.rs tests: inclusion in both briefs, content markers, no '@', no banned words, size cap.
Add the budgets.rs checker, the real-file test and the doctored-copy test.
Add the CHANGELOG.md entry and the docs/decisions.md entry.
Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: The parser is brittle against markdown edits.
risks.mitigation: The checker accepts only lines in the fixed form; the file states the form in a comment line. The test fails if a set is missing.

risks.risk: The file grows large and bloats every planner and critic call.
risks.mitigation: Keep the file short, and have the briefs test assert that it is below a byte cap, for example 6000 bytes.

risks.risk: The file trips the boundary or personal-data scan.
risks.mitigation: The briefs test checks the file for '@' and for each word from boundary_words(); the example remote in the file uses a placeholder.

risks.risk: A prompt edit changes a size, so the file goes stale. That is intended, but it can surprise.
risks.mitigation: The recorded sizes are for the estimator, and the producer takes them from the test's own computation.

demonstrations.method: Content review, aided by one test. A briefs test asserts that the file contains each required fact's marker phrase and a 'Source:' on every fact bullet. The verifier reads the file against the criterion's list.
demonstrations.observes: The test passes, and the file is short with a source on each of the listed facts.

demonstrations.method: A briefs test asserts that the file text has no '@', contains 'boundary_words' and 'xtask/tests/policy.rs', and contains none of the words returned by athena_context::briefs::boundary_words() (line 321).
Unit tests build PlannerInputs and CriticInputs with the existing fixtures in briefs.rs tests and assert that each output contains SYSTEM_FACTS.
demonstrations.observes: Both outputs contain the whole file text.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the section were not added to planner_brief or critic_brief, the contains assertion on SYSTEM_FACTS would fail.

demonstrations.method: Budgets tests: system_facts_budgets_match_computed passes on the real file. system_facts_drift_is_rejected changes one size or budget number in a copy and asserts the checker returns Err naming the set.
demonstrations.observes: The real file passes and the doctored copy is rejected.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the checker did not compare numbers, the doctored-copy test would find Ok instead of Err. If the file's numbers were stale, the real-file test would fail.

demonstrations.method: The existing every_role_set_is_within_its_budget and an_over_budget_role_set_fails run unchanged in the same test binary. The facts ride in the briefs, not in the frames, so the planner and critic sets do not change.
Review the diff of CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md.
demonstrations.observes: A CHANGELOG entry and a decisions entry covering the file, the brief inclusion and the drift test.

demonstrations.method: Run cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check at the root.

open_questions: Exact current sizes are not known until the budgets helper runs; the producer fills the file from the computed values, then re-runs the tests.
The file cannot say where to find each fact until the producer greps the sources (host_rules.rs, records_branch.rs, land.rs, the plan request parser); each fact needs a cited source path.
The brief fixtures in briefs.rs tests were not read; the producer reuses whatever exists.
